features: Visual Clarity in Reversed Payments: Improved visual distinction between original (cancelled) payments and reversal (compensation) operations in the payment list, preventing ambiguities.
Quick Filters on Statistic Cards: Financial summary cards in the payments tab are now clickable, allowing instant filtering of the table by withholding taxes or reversed operations.
Optimized Registration Flow: After registering a new payment, the success screen now correctly redirects to the list of made payments instead of invoices, streamlining the workflow.

Global UI Alignment: The interactive design system for statistic cards has been uniformly extended to the Invoices and Installment Collections lists, introducing quick filters and consistent visual transitions across the entire system.
UI/UX Improvements in Accounting Documents: Fixed text overflow issues on long notes and IBANs in the detail page, integrating responsive display of the Audit Trail for legal approvals.
Native PDF Document Infrastructure: Added the capability to generate and download the Supplier Payment Slip (Distinta) in PDF format, based on native templates.
PSR-4 Exceptions Refactoring: Completed the architectural refactoring of system exceptions to fully comply with PSR-4 standards.
Installment Collections Detail View: Added a read-only view to analytically explore the composition of an installment collection, highlighting if paid via direct payment or credit compensation.
Table Tooltips Optimization: Replaced native text tooltips with interactive HoverCards (Shadcn) for immediate and rich reading of amounts details in Invoices and Payments tables.
